uncertainty: All metric heights, projections and individual opening dimensions are visually calibrated estimates, not survey measurements.
Rear service fittings, inaccessible elevations and fine carving are interpreted; no interiors are modelled.
Current tenant service status is not inferred from historical imagery.
130C/132 frontage split is visually estimated at 10.2 m from the Post Office Avenue corner within the shared 31.15 m mapped range.
Historic rear gables are documented by the 2024 report; individual hidden opening locations remain estimated.
Rear architectural photographs date from the RGP portfolio (uploaded 2014); model does not claim current tenancy or exact current fittings.
Fine organic carving is an interpreted approximation; original inscription POST OFFICE is legible and modelled, but unreadable window notices are omitted.
